name: screenplay-scene
description:
Writes screenplay scenes in industry-standard format with slug lines, action lines, dialogue, and parentheticals. Enforces visual storytelling and proper screenplay conventions.
Use when the user asks to write a screenplay scene, script a scene, format dialogue for screen, or draft in screenplay format.
Do NOT use for prose fiction scenes (use scene-writing), stage plays (different format), dialogue-only exercises (use dialogue-writing), or full screenplay structure (use plot-outline for structure first).
